name: baidu-netdisk
description: 管理百度网盘中的云端文件与资料。未配置用户自己的 Access Token 时不连接账户，也不列出文件。

access_token.title: 百度网盘 Access Token
access_token.description: User-supplied OAuth access token for 百度网盘. No default. Required before the official MCP server or cloud file calls can run. This package does not create a Baidu account and does not invent a token.

app_key.title: 百度网盘 AppKey
app_key.description: Optional AppKey from the user's own open-platform application. Used only for authorization-code, refresh, and device-code exchange. Not required for the official personal MCP token flow.

secret_key.title: 百度网盘 SecretKey
secret_key.description: Optional SecretKey for the user's own application. Used only when exchanging or refreshing a token. Never printed by status.

redirect_uri.title: 授权回调地址
redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI registered on the user's own Baidu Netdisk application. Required only for the authorization-code exchange.

refresh_token.title: 百度网盘 Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Optional refresh token from a previous official token response. Single-use per Baidu's authorization-code document. Not printed by status.

app_dir.title: 应用目录
app_dir.description: Absolute /apps/{appname} directory for this application. Official file manager, upload, and download docs limit third-party access to that directory. When set, mutating calls must stay under it.
